propositions: Epic close gate must deterministically block when an open or in-progress bug records a caused_by edge into the epic subtree, mirroring the direct-children gate logic by scanning each bug's deps[] for reverse-directed edges.

Candidate filter identifies bugs for the haiku screen using two criteria: open/in_progress status AND (created after the epic's first open→in_progress transition OR linked any-relation-any-depth to the epic subtree), with a 32-candidate evaluation ceiling and overflow accounting.

Haiku relevance screen runs a single-turn forced-choice evaluation (A: describes defect in epic deliverable; B: pre-existing/adjacent; C: unrelated) using TRIVIAL_CLASS model with warm-then-fan-out orchestration, forwarding up to 8 A-verdicts as compact context inside the fenced precheck assembly.

Completion verifier adjudicates forwarded candidates by blocking only undispositioned deliverable-defects via store-grounded disposition signals: (a) supersedes/duplicates link or (b) reasoned pre-existence/supersession prose, never close_class.
Screen verdict output rides a registered epic_bug_screen_verdict schema with normalizing validator following the overlap_verdict idiom, degrading malformed outputs safely to C (unrelated).

Screen tally including per-bug verdicts and unevaluated-overflow count is recorded in the completion sidecar for audit and live FN calibration; screen failures degrade to open (logged) rather than blocking the close.
